commit_message:
Split trans.py: codec types to kv_codecs, add-ons to store_addons (#70) (#147)

- The codec types (Codec, ValueCodec, KeyCodec, KeyValueCodec, affix_key_codec)
  move to the dependency-free leaf dol/_codecs_core.py; dol.kv_codecs is their
  public home. A leaf, not kv_codecs itself, because kv_codecs loads zipfiledol
  and filesys at import time, and dol.trans must import the codec types eagerly
  (dependents star-import dol.trans) without changing dol's import order.
- Path access, flatten, method aliases and insert_hash_method move to the new
  dol/store_addons.py.
- dol.trans re-exports every moved name, so every import path keeps working.
  A new test snapshots each touched module's namespace as it was on master and
  asserts every name is still importable, and that re-exports are the moved
  objects themselves.

No behaviour change.

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
